description:
FOUND s473t6c (#1501 ROUND 10), probed vs perl 5.40.3, while closing #1023.

The LAST EXPRESSION of a string eval is emitted in LIST context whatever the
eval's OWN call-site context is, so a value perl collapses to a single scalar
comes back as a list and is then MEASURED.

REPRODUCER (perl | PCL):
    my %h = map { $_ => uc $_ } 'a'..'z';
    print scalar eval "%h{'c','d','e'}";      # perl E | PCL 6   (the pair count)
    print scalar eval "\@h{'c','d','e'}";     # perl E | PCL 3   (the element count)
    print scalar(%h{'c','d','e'});            # perl E | PCL E   (no eval: right)
    print scalar eval "my \$z = %h{'c','d','e'}; \$z";   # perl E | PCL E

The plain slice `@h{...}` diverges too, which is what says this is NOT a
kv-slice fact: it is the eval's emission context.  The fourth line is the
discriminator -- once the eval's body assigns to a scalar ITSELF, PCL is right,
so the value and the collapse rule are both fine and only the CONTEXT the
eval's own last expression is compiled in is wrong.

RELATION TO THE EXISTING NOT-SUPPORTED ENTRY.  `docs/not-supported.md`
"Context propagation into string eval" is about `wantarray()` INSIDE the eval,
and its measured table says scalar and list are already correct because the CL
dynamic `*wantarray*` binding is ambient at the `(load â¦)`.  That is a
different question from this one: here the eval's body is COMPILED with a list
context for its final expression, so the collapse never gets a chance to
happen at run time.  Add this shape to that section (or give it its own) when
it is fixed or ruled.

ROWS: perl-tests/kvhslice.t rows 9 and 11 (blessed fails; they used to carry
#1023, whose own reproducer `scalar(%h{'c','d','e'})` now PASSES after s473t6c's
#1923).  t/op/kvhslice.t's `eval` rows are the companion twins.

SIZE: not a filler.  The eval transpile is a separate `pl2cl` run whose result
is CACHED by the eval text plus the capture NAMES (#296-B1); giving the body
its caller's context means putting that context in the key too, or binding it
at the emission seam.  Measure the cache-key cost before designing.
subject: SILENT WRONG: the LAST EXPRESSION of a string eval is emitted in LIST context whatever the call site is -- `scalar eval "%h{a,b}"` is the COUNT, perl gives the last value
